subject: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path for Redwood (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia@lumenai.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path for Redwood (recap + next steps)

Hi Sofia, great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Call recap:
- Team: Sofia (Procurement), +2 from LumenAI procurement; Jonas (Solutions), Camila (Marketplace ops), Marissa (Sales).
- Primary ask: understand LumenAI procurement path for a production Redwood deployment and whether you prefer a marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP/Azure) vs direct PO / credit card.
- Timeline: target production pilot in Dec/Jan; procurement kickoff immediately helpful.

Open items / questions for procurement:
1) Procurement route: do you need a PO/invoice (Net 30) for initial commit, or can the pilot run on a company card?
2) Marketplace preference: Are you interested in AWS Marketplace listing (recommended for your AWS-first infra) or would GCP/Azure be preferred?
3) Marketplace path: if AWS Marketplace, do you have an existing internal process for procurement through marketplace subscriptions, or do we need to support a direct invoice/PO?
4) Required docs: we attached our SOC 2 report and an initial pricing spreadsheet for reference. What vendor onboarding docs/forms do you need (W-9, Vendor Form, COI, etc.)?

Suggested next steps:
- Sofia: confirm preferred procurement path (PO vs card) and point person for vendor onboarding (procurement@lumenai.com is OK).
- Camila: I'll loop Camila to explain AWS Marketplace timeline and what listing vs offer subscription looks like.
- Marissa: will prepare a formal quote and SOW draft for your procurement team once we have path confirmed.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-v1.xlsx, redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf

Thanks — we'll keep this thread as the single thread for procurement coordination.


Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sofia Torres <sofia@lumenai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path for Redwood (recap + next steps)

Hi Jonas, thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Preferred path: For anything enterprise (> $25k) we do PO / invoice (Net 30). Smaller pilots sometimes run on corporate card but for a production pilot we'll need a PO.
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace for AWS-hosted services that simplifies internal approvals. We also use GCP internally for some teams but primary channel should be AWS.
- Vendor onboarding: procurement@lumenai.com is the right place. I attached our vendor onboarding checklist and standard terms so you can see what to expect. We'll need your W-9, SOC 2 report (you've attached), and a standard MSA or reseller agreement.
- Timeline: if we can get the quote + vendor form this week, legal/procurement aim to issue PO within 7-10 business days.

Next step: Please send the formal quote and any marketplace listing info (AWS Marketplace process) to procurement@lumenai.com and cc me.

Best,
Sofia Torres
Head of Procurement | LumenAI
sofia@lumenai.com

Attachment: lumenai-vendor-checklist.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Sofia Torres <sofia@lumenai.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path for Redwood (recap + next steps)

Thanks, Sofia, helpful and clear. A few notes on our side so procurement knows expectations and options:

- AWS Marketplace path: we can publish a Private Offer or a SaaS contract in AWS Marketplace. Typical timeline for listing + private offer is ~3-6 weeks depending on required reviews; if you need a private offer we can start the AWS intake immediately.
- Direct PO / Invoice: We can accept a PO (Net 30) against a standard Redwood sales order. For PO path we'll need: PO number, billing address, and contact for invoice reconciliation.
- Documents we will provide this morning: W-9, SOC 2 (attached), initial quote/price sheet, draft SOW. If you prefer marketplace subscription, Camila will handle the AWS intake and provide expected listing timeline and required marketplace metadata.

Action items:
- Marissa: will send formal quote + SOW (see attached draft).
- Camila: please include a short note on AWS Marketplace steps, who on your side we should engage at AWS (if you have a vendor manager), and expected ETA for listing.
- Procurement: please confirm the vendor onboarding contact and any additional required forms beyond the checklist.

AWS Marketplace link (for reference): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/tour/listing/


Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-w9.pdf, redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf, redwood-sow-draft.docx, redwood-pricing-v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia@lumenai.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path for Redwood (recap + next steps)

Hi Sofia / Procurement team — looping in Marissa from sales (me) to move the quote/SOW to you. Per discussion, attached is the formal quote and SOW draft keyed to the pilot scope we discussed. Two quick asks to keep momentum:

1) Please confirm preferred procurement path (AWS Marketplace subscription vs PO/invoice). If PO, please share the PO number and billing contact when ready.
2) If Marketplace: confirm you want a Private Offer (we submit an offer to AWS that you accept) or a public SaaS listing (we recommend Private Offer for enterprise pricing). That decision affects ETA.

If it helps, I can set up a 30-minute call with your procurement/finance team this week to walk through the quote and marketplace options. Otherwise, I'll wait for the PO or Marketplace confirmation and will send the DocuSign order form as soon as we have direction.

DocuSign link (order form): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/placeholder-signature/abcdef

Attachments: redwood-pricing-v1.xlsx, redwood-sow-draft.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting you up and running.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0167
